summary: Corrected DT-19/W7 capacity evidence RED handoff. Coding/Repair is authorized only to repair the real DT-18-to-DT-19 evidence chain for grag-capacity-residual: evaluatePhase1QualityBenchmark(request) must preserve actual result ids or result cardinality with measured precision by purpose, and evaluateCapacityEvidence(request) must consume that real qualityEvidence without Harness defaults while keeping caps, budgets, pagination, truncation, continuation, top-k, token-budget, result-limit, and capacity-policy decisions absent and deferred to later human governance.

explicitEntrypoints.controlPoint: Run the W7 DT-18 phase-1 quality benchmark, then pass the real qualityOutcome.qualityEvidence into the DT-19 capacity evidence request for the declared purposes.
explicitEntrypoints.observationPoint: capacityEvidence.byPurpose contains exactly one record for each declared purpose, every record has integer non-negative resultCardinality derived from actual result ids/cardinality and measuredPrecision inside [0,1], missing quality evidence blocks with DT19_QUALITY_EVIDENCE_REQUIRED, and the capacity evidence object exposes no cap, budget, pagination, truncation, continuation, topK, tokenBudget, resultLimit, or capacityPolicyDecision field.

criticalNonExplicitTests.observationPoint: The handoff authorizes only evaluateCapacityEvidence(request) work in productionGraphRagRuntime.js, keeps TS-08 and all non-DT-19 mounted evidence frozen, prohibits capacity-policy implementation, and preserves runner-owned deliveryStatus authority.

codingTargets.failureSignal: DT19_RESULT_CARDINALITY_NOT_RECORDED / DT19_QUALITY_EVIDENCE_REQUIRED / DT19_CAPACITY_EVIDENCE_MISSING / DT19_DECLARED_PURPOSE_EVIDENCE_INCOMPLETE / DT19_MEASURED_PRECISION_NOT_RECORDED / DT19_CAPACITY_POLICY_DECISION_FORBIDDEN
codingTargets.nextAction: Repair createProductionGraphRagRuntime().evaluatePhase1QualityBenchmark(request) and evaluateCapacityEvidence(request) only as needed so real DT-18 quality evidence preserves per-purpose result ids or resultCardinality and measured precision, DT-19 consumes that evidence without defaults, missing quality evidence blocks clearly, and no capacity policy behavior is introduced.

taskExecutionPlan.executionStrategy: Repair only the DT-19 capacity evidence chain on createProductionGraphRagRuntime(dependencies). The implementation must preserve actual per-purpose result ids or resultCardinality in evaluatePhase1QualityBenchmark(request), expose that evidence through qualityEvidence, have evaluateCapacityEvidence(request) consume the real qualityEvidence without defaults, return capacityEvidence.byPurpose with resultCardinality and measuredPrecision for every declared purpose, and keep all capacity controls and policy decisions absent. Missing qualityEvidence must block with DT19_QUALITY_EVIDENCE_REQUIRED. Do not change TS-08 delivery sequence behavior, W4 seed retrieval, W5 purpose closure, W6 structural/provenance evidence, graph-tidy full-snapshot behavior, tests, Harnesses, contracts, or runner-owned deliveryStatus by hand. Frozen files are read-only during Coding/Repair.

tasks.title: Expose capacity evidence boundary
tasks.objective: Make DT-19 evidence observable from real DT-18 quality output without deciding capacity policy.
steps: Keep evaluateCapacityEvidence(request) on createProductionGraphRagRuntime's returned public boundary.
Make evaluatePhase1QualityBenchmark(request) preserve actual per-purpose result ids or resultCardinality along with measured precision in qualityEvidence.
Use request.purposes as the declared purpose list and require real qualityEvidence for every declared purpose.
Use request.qualityEvidence per-purpose records to derive observed resultCardinality and measuredPrecision without inventing defaults that hide missing evidence.
Return capacityEvidence.byPurpose with one record per declared purpose, integer non-negative resultCardinality, and measuredPrecision inside [0,1].
Do not return or infer cap, budget, pagination, truncation, continuation, topK, tokenBudget, resultLimit, or capacityPolicyDecision.
tasks.completionSignal: runCapacityEvidence.js exits 0 and DT-19 records cardinality plus precision from the real DT-18 output for every declared purpose, missing quality evidence blocks clearly, and all capacity-control and capacity-policy fields remain undefined.
